name: Panama Product Import (XML, CSV, YML)
author: PanamaCode

sections.description:
Panama Product Import is a fast and flexible WooCommerce product import plugin designed for dropshipping stores, marketplaces, supplier-based businesses and stores working with XML, CSV and YML product feeds, including large product catalogs.

Import products from supplier feeds, including remote feeds via URL, and keep your catalog up to date using reliable batch processing, flexible field mapping, product synchronization and manual or automated workflows.

🚀 Built for real WooCommerce stores

Perfect for:

  • Dropshipping stores
  • WooCommerce stores with multiple suppliers
  • Marketplaces and aggregators
  • Businesses that need automated product updates

Designed for stores working with large product catalogs and frequently changing data such as prices, stock and descriptions.

Built with a focus on stability, control and predictable import behavior — even when working with large feeds (10,000+ products).

🔹 Supported feed formats

• XML
• YML
• CSV
• Remote feeds via URL

🔥 KEY FEATURES (FREE VERSION)

✔ Import products from XML, CSV, YML
✔ Manual import with fast batch processing (AJAX + REST)
✔ Pause / Resume import at any time
✔ Auto-pause on page reload (session restore)
✔ Feed preview (structure + fields detection)
✔ Field mapping (title, short description, full description)
✔ Combine multiple fields into one
✔ Category mapping (1 category for whole feed)
✔ Product update by key (SKU / article / vendorCode)
✔ Live import log
✔ Import history
✔ Multi-language interface (25+ languages)
✔ Dark / Light UI mode

⚡ PERFORMANCE & STABILITY

  • Handles large feeds (10k–25k+ products)
  • Uses XMLReader (low memory consumption)
  • Batch-based import engine
  • Import session system (running / paused / finished)
  • Backend-driven logic (frontend is UI only)

🔧 HOW IT WORKS

  1. Add your product feed (XML / CSV / YML)
  2. Preview structure and available fields
  3. Map required fields
  4. Start import
  5. Monitor progress via live log
  6. Pause / Resume anytime

🌍 SUPPORTED LANGUAGES

Ukrainian, English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Czech, Romanian, Hungarian, Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Turkish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Arabic, Korean, Greek, Russian, Polish, Indonesian, Vietnamese

🔹 Advanced features (PRO version)

• MultiFeed support (multiple supplier feeds)
• Scheduled imports with CRON
• Advanced category mapping by feed values
• Automatic WooCommerce category creation
• Product attributes import (CSV and XML/YML)
• Global and local attributes management
• Control number of imported product images
• Stock quantity and availability import
• Import rules and conditions (filters)
• Advanced automation and import workflows

🔹 Why choose Panama Product Import?

• Built specifically for WooCommerce product feeds
• Designed for supplier-based workflows and MultiFeed setups
• Stable import for large catalogs (10k+ products)
• Clear and predictable import logic
• Clean interface without unnecessary complexity
• Ongoing improvements and active development

🔹 Upgrade to PRO

Upgrade to Panama Product Import PRO to access:
• MultiFeed support
• Scheduled CRON imports
• Advanced category mapping
• Product attributes import
• Global attributes
• Stock quantity import
• Product availability import
• Advanced automation workflows

The PRO version includes ongoing updates, improvements and dedicated support for long-term use in production WooCommerce stores.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/panama-product-import
    or install via WordPress Plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Panama Product Import
  4. Add your feed
  5. Configure mapping
  6. Run import
sections.faq:
What file formats are supported?

XML, CSV and YML feeds are supported.

Can I import large product catalogs?

Yes. The plugin is designed to handle large feeds (10,000+ products) using batch processing.

Can I pause and resume import?

Yes. Import can be paused and resumed anytime. The session is stored temporarily and may expire after a period of inactivity.

How are products updated?

Products are updated using selected key: SKU, article or vendorCode.

Does it support scheduled import?

Scheduled import (CRON) is available in Pro version.

What is the difference between Free and Pro?

Free version supports a single feed and core import features.
Pro version adds automation, multi-feed support, advanced mapping and attributes.
